notes.notes: [p]Hi, I`m Live streaming, some free time chat and demo gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
New Updates!

I`m sorry for not implementing Steam Input. I`m working on it, but it takes time to fully implement the Steam API into the UE5 engine.

Here is a list of new updates

[list]
[*] New tutorial level with better explanation of gameplay functions
[*] New enemy iterations, new colors represent harder enemies.
[*] Added Use button for switch toggling
[*] Added Melee attack for all characters
[*] Added switches that can only be used by shooting at them
[*] Added Steam Leaderboards
[*] Added Steam achievements
[*] Added environment trap ( spikes! )
[*] Character movement is more responsive
[*] Fixed platform position at mini-Boss fight (it was too easy)
[*] Fixed bullet spawn position (now they are spawning at the barrel)
[*] Added more graffiti and environment textures
[*] Added Last run time and kill score
[/list]

Thank you for being so supportive, and see you soon.

Ania and Marcin

notes.title: Demo relese
notes.notes:
Hey,

Here’s the first playable demo we’ve been working on for almost half a year!

We’re a two-person indie micro-studio from Western Pomerania in Poland. Games are our passion and a way to relax. Both of us (my wife and I) work in game dev, but for a long time, we’ve wanted to create something of our own—something we’d love to play ourselves.

We invite you to test our demo!

SU42: Hired Gun offers single-player gameplay, two-player co-op, and Steam Remote Play, allowing you to play together on one screen over the internet.

Let us know how much you enjoy the gameplay—we’re looking forward to all your feedback!

Ania & Marcin
